buckets.entry: entry/qualification/technical work (cap 4 GPU-h, includes the gate trajectory, qualification, technical batch and any repair GPU work)
buckets.main: development M0, development trajectories, development generation and scoring, held-out training
buckets.reserve: protected 8 GPU-h: held-out M0/generation/scoring and publication verification

decode_accounting: artifacts/decode_counts/<job>.jsonl, per-image, kinds primary|technical; unexpected decodes charged as technical
frozen_before: any numerical loss test, detector inference or FLUX output
gpu_device_hours_note: charged = (allocated devices) x (wall from launch to confirmed reaping), never clipped; reservations = max_wall + grace per device before launch
monitoring_coverage: documented in artifacts/ledger coverage_and_gaps(); unknown totals are not exact compliance claims

projection.conservatism: all 36 trajectories projected at 250 states; gate trajectory counted again
projection.formula: see code/cprd2/project.py (committed); fits iff all four inequalities hold: non_reserve_fits, reserve_fits, total_fits, wall_fits_before_day6_stop; otherwise RESOURCE_BLOCKED
projection.inputs: measured seconds/state from the native gate trajectory, measured seconds/image from the 4-case technical batch, measured detector load + per-image time
